question: Which of the following is known as Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daria Daulat Bagh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daria Daulat Bagh is known as Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace.**
 
• Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace in Srirangapatna, also referred to as Dariya Daulat Bagh.
 
• Tipu Sultan's summer palace was built during 1778-1784 AD.
 
• Construction of the palace was initiated by Hyder Ali (Tipu Sultan's father) and completed by Tipu Sultan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tipu Sultan was the ruler of Mysore.
 
• Tipu Sultan is well known as the “Tiger of Mysore”.
 
• He had the image of the tiger on his flag.
 
• He is the son of powerful Mysore ruler Haidar Ali.
 
• Tipu Sultan ruled Mysore from 1782 to 1799.
